title: OpenEvoShield: Dual Non-Stationary Continual Defense for Open-World Multi-Agent System Attacks

object.carrier: 多智能体系统的行为边界与策略集成（M2 边界更新器、M3 EWC 正则化策略集成）随部署持续更新；攻击侧注入经智能体间通信传播

safety_property.statement: 多智能体系统在攻击策略持续精炼、正常智能体行为随系统扩张漂移的双重非平稳条件下，仍应阻断恶意指令传播并保持正常协作
safety_property.operationalized_as: 三个任务域（CSQA/MMLU/GSM8K）的 ASR 与 MDSR、InjecAgent/ PoisonRAG 的 TA/MA、以及 Novel-DR 与 FPR

capabilities: 经智能体间通信注入并传播恶意指令
针对已部署防御精炼注入策略
assumptions: 正常智能体行为同时随系统扩张漂移
攻击与正常两侧漂移可分离
not_covered: 单智能体的持久语义记忆

intervention.name: OpenEvoShield（M1 非对称速率控制 + M2 正常边界更新 + M3 EWC 策略集成 + M4 能量多粒度检测）
intervention.description: 用双漂移信号把攻击侧快学习率与正常侧慢学习率解耦；M2 以慢速率维护动态行为边界；M3 以 EWC 正则化快速适配且不灾难遗忘；M4 融合节点/子图/系统多层能量检测

results.claim: 面对分布漂移，静态防御大幅退化而 OpenEvoShield 仅小幅上升：Phase II 中 INFA-GUARD 的 CSQA ASR 从 23.3% 升至 45.8%（+22.5pp），OpenEvoShield 仅从 20.1% 升到 24.5%（+4.4pp）
results.setting: Phase II 分布漂移下的 CSQA 攻击
results.quote: In Phase II, INFA-GUARD’s CSQA ASR surges from 23.3%23.3\% to 45.8%45.8\% (+22.5 pp) as its static classifier overfits to Phase I prototypes, while OpenEvoShield rises only 20.1%→24.5%20.1%\!\to\!24.5% (+4.4

results.claim: M4 检测头在 Phase III 达到 61.8% Novel-DR，比 Naive-Continual 高 42.5pp，同时保持最低 ASR
results.setting: Phase III 未见攻击检测率
results.quote: OpenEvoShield’s M4 achieves 61.8%\mathbf{61.8\%} Novel-DR—42.542.5 pp above Naive-Continual—while sustaining the lowest Phase III ASR.

results.claim: M3 策略更新器最关键：移除后 Phase II ASR 上升 13.4pp，Phase III Novel-DR 崩到 35.8%（−26.0pp）
results.quote: M3 (Policy Updater) is the most critical: its removal raises Phase II ASR by +13.4+13.4 pp and collapses Phase III Novel-DR to 35.8%35.8\% (−26.0-26.0 pp).

results.claim: M1 非对称速率移除后误报率近乎翻倍（4.2%→8.5%），因更新速率失控导致过度适配
results.quote: M1’s removal nearly doubles FPR (4.2%→8.5%4.2%\!\to\!8.5\%), as uncontrolled update rates cause the system to over-adapt and misclassify normal agents.

limitations.statement: 防御对象是多智能体共享状态，与单智能体语义记忆载体不同；跨载体外推需谨慎
